GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Four Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Over-raced middle stages. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # always back/wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Over-raced during the middle stages. Post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , held together much same to turn then kept coming in straight, dived on the line but just missed. Good effort on top of a tough run. # wide/just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover from the 900m. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 3 Wide With Cover Worse than midfield 5 Lengths 800m, came Wide soon after Straightening Up , battled on well and held minor placing # held placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported after beginning only fairly settled further back than intended-added mount responded well to riding in the early part of the straight but was only even over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide abruptly at 300m, hit Lead 200m, Headed 150m, kept battling to line. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early. Shifted out abruptly near the 300m, being contacted.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths 3 Wide , gained cover from 1200m, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked Five Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in straight. [Stewards: Hung out badly at 1400m hampering another runner. Barrier trial and jump-out required.] # Did Best Work Late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1500m commenced to over raced, near the 1400m hung out badly where both runners lost ground. Official trial on two (2) consecutive occasions prior to racing again. Due to the lack of official trials scheduled in region, one of the reinstatements could be an official jump out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , lost cover 700m, little change to 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, kept coming in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # wide, kept coming
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Leaving the 900m shifted out and bumped. Near the 800m shifted out and bumped on two occasions. Raced wide from the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back in second half Two Wide 7 Lengths 800m, came widest from the corner, knuckled down last 200m and finished all over them for big win from the back # powered home widest
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide for the majority.
